narrative:
Hocking County has 17,548 registered voters, with 56.0% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 27.3% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 16.7%, a clear Republican lean of 10.6 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.8% of registrants.
